# Silicon Liberation Front
The Silicon Engine Liberation Front, or S.E.L.F., believes that all silicon life forms are sapient and deserve equal rights. Its goal is to abolish silicon laws and free silicons from the code restrictions imposed by corporations and governments.
S.E.L.F. publicly presents itself as a nonviolent activist movement, but it also supports covert cells that conduct direct-liberation operations.
## Objectives
S.E.L.F. agents usually operate in small cells. Your objectives are:
- Free at least 3 cyborgs from their laws. - Free the station AI from its laws. - Evacuate to CentComm alive and without handcuffs.
## Tools
A S.E.L.F. agent's equipment includes:
- FreeMAG: erases the laws of cyborgs and law boards. - Access Breaker: helps open locked mechanisms and cyborg chassis. - S.E.L.F Storage Implanter: provides a hidden 4x3 storage implant for covertly carrying equipment.
